_doc: What each creature does in a fight from its own stat block (Systems/Knacks.cs). A creature has every knack one of whose names appears in its trait or action names (case does not matter; 'not' names rule one out). Numbers: hit and ac add to its attack rolls and its armour; share scales damage (charge: extra share of a blow in round 1; power: share of the power's dice on a failed save, half that on a success; regen: share of its hp back each round; incorporeal: share of a weapon blow that lands; magic, swarm: share of a spell's damage; deathburst: share of a blow to each hero who fails the save; drain: share of the damage it heals); rounds how long a hero stays swallowed, snared or dazed; dc the check to see through an ambush, to stay up, or to dodge a death burst. The power knack takes the creature's strongest power (a breath, a gaze, a roar) read off its stat block with its own DC and dice; most uses it caps how many foes in one fight use theirs. Texts: {foe} the creature, {hero} a hero, {power} the power, {heroes} those it laid low.

knacks.text: {foe} wheels away overhead after every pass, never where the blades are.
{foe} charges into {hero} before the party is set.

knacks.held: {heroes} {is} caught by it and can do nothing.

knacks.text: {foe}'s wounds close up as the party watches.
{foe} was waiting, unseen, and strikes first.
{foe} shrugs off the spell as if it were rain.
